summary: ADR 0030 (accepted): --ui-ease-out is cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), was (0, 0, 0.2, 1) — the old curve covered 58% of its journey at a quarter of its duration and 84% at half, so a 200ms move read like ~300ms; the new one covers 76% and 96%, the curve transitions.dev, bencho and animate-ui each use. Durations unchanged. --ui-stagger-step is 40ms, was 100ms: Stagger's six-item cap lands in 200ms instead of 500ms. New --ui-tick (100ms, 0 at Reduced and Off) carries the beat of computed repeating animations — StatusMatrix's shared clock and the home plates — which had been reading the stagger step and would otherwise have run 2.5x faster. A brand that slowed StatusMatrix through --ui-stagger-step retunes --ui-tick instead. Literal curve assertions (Button, Thumbnail, Toast, the token emitter) and the design-component filmstrip helper's default now name the new curve.
